title.zh: perworld L v2 诊断轮证据归档（attempt1 环境失败无 dump / attempt2 成功 dump 68b3f78e…/51,388 B；独立 diagnostic round）
title.en: Per-world L v2 diagnostic-round evidence archive (attempt 1 failed on launch env with no dump; attempt 2 succeeded with dump 68b3f78e…/51,388 B; independent diagnostic round)

intent.zh: 承载 `2026-11-11-render-perworld-l-v2-entity-diagnostic-dump` 诊断轮的执行证据目录：README/receipt/manifest + window/ 记录（attempt1 环境失败、attempt2 env 自检、单次运行日志、dump identity）。按 normify 规则，已关闭的诊断卡不能扩展 `schedule.files` 范围（实测 E change/transition + E commit/scope），因此证据目录由本独立证据卡承载；诊断卡随后以 Normify-Fixes addenda 引用本证据提交。dump 本体不入库（留 target/ 供 Arch 只读分析），证据只录 sha256/bytes 与摘自 dump 的表格。本卡零 GPU、不改代码/判据/阈值/参考/冻结件。
intent.en: Owns the diagnostic-round evidence directory for `2026-11-11-render-perworld-l-v2-entity-diagnostic-dump`: README/receipt/manifest + window/ records (attempt 1 launch-env failure, attempt 2 env self-check, single-run logs, dump identity). Under normify rules a closed diagnostic card cannot extend its `schedule.files` scope (observed E change/transition + E commit/scope), so the evidence directory is owned by this separate evidence card; the diagnostic card then references this evidence commit through a Normify-Fixes addenda. The dump itself is not committed (stays under target/ for Arch read-only analysis); the evidence records only sha256/bytes and tables extracted from the dump. Zero GPU, no code/criterion/threshold/reference/frozen-artifact changes.

acceptance: **证据内容**：证据目录 `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/perworld-l-v2-entity-diagnostic-dump/` 含 README.md、receipt.json、manifest.txt 与 window/ 记录（attempt1 preflight/failure/日志、attempt2 body-env/preflight2/no-run/运行日志、pixel-dump-identity.txt）；README 如实写明 attempt1（NVRTC PATH 缺失、无 dump、未消耗轮次）与 attempt2（env 自检、dump sha/bytes、测试 exit 101 预期、wall、诊断 exe sha）、6 个 world×cam 摘要、5 个失配像素全量表、near-miss 摘要、与 G-L2 断言只看到 2 px 的关系、非声明。

**dump 不入库**：`pixel-dump.json` 仅留 `target/`（已 ignored），证据只记录 sha256 `68b3f78ed9586a83c47cfad8ab722407d27c8571cd82c92a5f9b4c6050326089`/51,388 B 与表格；诊断 exe 不进 guards，guards/冻结 stash/12 冻结 exe 证据/G-L2 证据零改动。
**边界**：零 GPU、不重跑、不改代码；`unchanged src/`、`unchanged tests/`、`unchanged fixtures/`、`unchanged scripts/`；本卡只新增证据目录。
**门禁与自核**：fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit 全过（unit 1,387 过 0 败）；manifest 12/12 自核、UTF-8/LF/无 BOM；README/receipt/manifest 的 sha/bytes 在提交报告与 receipt 中记录。
**非声明**：本卡不改变 G-L2 判定（判据 A FAIL 维持）、不宣称根因已定位、不宣称任何数值等价；不改判据/阈值/参考/相机/recipe。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 04:55 要求把诊断轮结果记录进诊断卡证据并收口。normify 规则下已关闭诊断卡不能扩展 files 范围（实测 E change/transition「已关闭任务只能追加 addenda」+ E commit/scope），故以本独立证据卡承载证据目录；诊断卡以 `normify fix` addenda 引用本证据提交。零 GPU、不重跑、不改代码/判据/冻结件；dump 不入库（target/ 留 Arch 只读）。
